android.desc:
Elm Social Route is a map-based social app that lets you discover and share local spots, chat with nearby people, and plan trips — all with privacy at its core.

Features:

LOCAL MAP CHAT 
Place your chats directly on the map so others can discover them by location. Whether it's a hidden café, a scenic trail, or a local event — pin it, share it, and let the map tell the story.

GEOFENCED CHAT 
Some conversations are just for the locals. Create location-based chats only visible to nearby users — perfect for neighborhood updates, local tips, or spontaneous meetups.

CHATS WITH EVENTS 
Attach real context to your conversations. Add a location, a custom route, or a full trip to your chat — so your message comes with everything others need to join in or follow along.

CUSTOM ROUTE BUILDER 
Build and share your own routes with paths, connectors, and markers. Share a hiking trail, a city walk, or a road trip route — exactly as you experienced it.

TRAVEL PLANNER (TRIP PLANNER)
Organize your adventures with the built-in trip planner. Add locations, routes, chats, or other trips, arrange them in order, and let the auto-connect feature link everything together seamlessly.

COLLABORATIVE TRIP PLANNING (TRIP COLAB)
Planning with friends? Trip members can collaboratively edit a shared trip.

CHAT EXPIRATION 
Chats have an expiration date. Once expired, comments lock and the chat moves down the list — keeping the feed fresh, relevant, and clutter-free.

REPS
Forget likes. Elm uses a reputation system — Reps — to surface quality content and reward genuine contributions from the community.

PRIVATE & SECURE 
Privacy isn't an afterthought here — it's the foundation. Elm Social Route is designed from the ground up to give you control over who sees your content and where.

SPAM REDUCTION 
A combination of chat expiration, Reps, and AI-powered reporting will keep the community cleaner and less spam.

WHO IS ELM SOCIAL ROUTE FOR?
Anyone who values a private and secure map based social experience.
Friend groups planning collaborative trips together.
Locals who want to share neighborhood discoveries with people nearby.
Travelers and tourists looking for a local travel guide and trip planner.

quotes.text:
I had released my app Elm Social Route. It main features are to create geofenced chats, shares location-specific events, and plan trips with routes. It use geohash as geofencing. Has robust custom route built. And using Reps (Reputations) to replace likes. What you think?

I build it in 5 (feels long) years btw, and more if the similar predecessors I built before was counted.

PS: I use AI on user report to judge the post.
